name: Long March 8A
location_str: Commercial LC-1 @ Wenchang Space Launch Site, CHN
slot_a_text: The 46th launch of the year for China's CASC, 616th all time. 8th from Commercial LC-1 this year, 50 days since the last one. The 229th orbital launch attempt worldwide this year.
slot_b_text: Orbit is not about being high above Earth. It is about falling toward Earth fast enough that the ground keeps curving away.
rocket_fact: Orbit is not about being high above Earth. It is about falling toward Earth fast enough that the ground keeps curving away.
